VMS Layout Tool

  1. Show your bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B).
  2. Drag this button onto the bar: VMS Layout Tool
  3. Log in to OMNIA, then click the bookmark. The tool opens in a new tab and uses your existing OMNIA session.

If the browser blocks the new tab, allow pop-ups for the OMNIA site; until then the tool opens on top of the OMNIA page. If it blocks bookmarklets, paste the script below into the developer console (F12) on the OMNIA page instead.

Rebuild after changing src/: node build.js
